[[Premiere (Kabal)|Premiere]] '''Jan Dovu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a [[firebomb]] detonated near him during the riots in [[Shoribus]].
